analysis_unit: independent paired process block; requests are subsamples
primary_metric: ordinary median of 30*C steady per-request latencies; geometric mean paired R0/R1
scope: SKV6 to SKV5, single physical HCA per worker, one route, 512KiB stripes, forced server disk read, warm OS page cache, recovery disabled
timing_boundary: request excludes subsequent full-pattern hashing; concurrency4 batch wall/CPU includes coordination and hashing; concurrency1 CPU narrower
adoption: opt-in/default off; no inference, production, p99 or dual-HCA claim
